qs.s: Érasme est connu pour sa pensée profondément ___.
qs.en: Erasmus is known for his profoundly humanist thought.

qs.en: This 16th-century literary movement championed a humanist philosophy centered on man.

qs.s: Érasme était un grand ___ de la Renaissance.
qs.en: Erasmus was a great humanist of the Renaissance.

qs.s: Cet ___ a consacré sa vie à l'étude des textes anciens.
qs.en: This humanist devoted his life to studying ancient texts.

qs.s: Les philosophes ___ ont marqué la Renaissance.
qs.en: The humanist philosophers marked the Renaissance.

qs.s: Ses idéaux ___ influencent encore les penseurs modernes.
qs.en: His humanist ideals still influence modern thinkers.

qs.s: Elle défend une pensée ___ fondée sur le respect de l'individu.

qs.en: This humanist association helps refugees in need.

qs.s: Après dix ans d'enseignement, elle a décidé de prendre une année ___.

qs.s: Mon collègue est en congé ___ pour écrire un livre.

qs.en: Some employees get sabbatical leaves after several years of service.

qs.en: University institutes sometimes offer sabbatical semesters to their researchers.

qs.en: She is preparing her project during her sabbatical year.

qs.en: Some companies grant sabbatical years every seven years.

qs.s: Les périodes ___ permettent aux chercheurs de se ressourcer.
qs.en: Sabbatical periods allow researchers to recharge.

qs.s: Mon frère a épousé Claire, qui est maintenant ma ___.
qs.en: My brother married Claire, who is now my sister-in-law.

qs.s: Depuis le mariage de mon frère, sa femme est ma ___.
qs.en: Since my brother's wedding, his wife has been my sister-in-law.

qs.s: La soeur de mon mari est ma ___.
qs.en: My husband's sister is my sister-in-law.

qs.s: Ma femme a une soeur qui est donc ma ___.
qs.en: My wife has a sister who is therefore my sister-in-law.

qs.s: ___ belle-soeur de Marc travaille à l'hôpital.
qs.en: Marc's sister-in-law works at the hospital.

qs.s: Marc a ___ belle-soeur qui vit à Nice.
qs.en: Marc has a sister-in-law who lives in Nice.
